integrity: The proof identifies local prime-power matrices explicitly, uses integral unimodular operations and Chinese-remainder tensor products, and assembles Smith factors by sorted local valuations. The 39 exact independent tests are documented. No independent mathematical audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Only the canonical unit-indexed Ramanujan difference-Gram matrix is classified, not arbitrary Fourier subsets or integer circulants. Local Ramanujan identities and complete-graph Smith forms are classical inputs. Earlier general implicit evaluations remain a historical coverage risk. Finite tests are corroborative, not infinite proofs.
title: Integral Smith classification of primitive-position Ramanujan Gram matrices
